items.title: David Spinozza interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, NY, September 27, 2025
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You know you just gave me a flash because I was able to interview Howard Johnson. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh sure. I know him well.

ctx.x: I would say, yes, yes. Probably because when I came up I was a rhythm & blues guitar player basically. I wouldn’t – I never really considered myself a jazz guitarist. Because I certainly listened to a lot of jazz players: Wes Montgomery, Joe Pass, people like that, you know, Chuck Wayne. I knew all these guitarists. I knew who they were. But I was mostly playing rhythm & blues. I had horn bands and I learned to arrange because the horns would say, “Well what do we play?” And I started to figure out how to write…
You know you just gave me a flash because I was able to interview Howard Johnson.
Oh sure. I know him well.
